results.broken_definition: The scenario version of this result cannot be read any more, so the field list may be incomplete.
results.sub: What the bot collected in scenarios and where it was sent.

waiting.event: an event from an external system
waiting.receipt_review: a person to check the receipt

chat.sub: All conversations with clients and how the bot made each reply.
chat.window_closed: closed: the client wrote more than 24 hours ago

by.variant: sent by a person, the bot's variant
by.variant_edited: sent by a person, the bot's variant with edits

sandbox.handover: The client asked for a person. In a real channel the bot would go silent here and call your team.
sandbox.reset_confirm: Start over? The bot will forget everything this test client has said.
sandbox.sub: Write to the bot the way a client would. Nothing is sent to real clients or to your systems.
sandbox.attach: Attach a photo or a receipt
sandbox.attachment_hint: A public https address of a photo or a receipt: the bot gets it as if the client had sent the file.
sandbox.decision_mode: Who decides what to do next
sandbox.settings_sub: Needed to compare models. If nothing is changed, the bot answers the same way as to real clients.
sandbox.reasoning_off: Does not think, answers at once
sandbox.start: Write the first message as a client
sandbox.start_sub: For example, the way clients usually begin: «Hello, I'd like to book».
sandbox.message_label: A message on behalf of the client
sandbox.slow: The bot answers in 10–15 seconds — the same as to real clients.
sandbox.learned_empty: No scenario has started yet. When the bot starts one, the answers it has collected appear here.
sandbox.why_here: The breakdown of this answer is on the right
sandbox.why_below: The breakdown of this answer is below

progress.partial: the answer is not complete yet

why.title: Why the bot answered this way
why.empty: Send a message — the breakdown of the answer appears here: what the bot understood, what it found and what it decided.
why.full: The whole breakdown of the step

understood.title: Understood from the message
understood.started: The client needs “{scenario}” — the scenario is started
understood.cancelled: The client changed their mind — “{scenario}” is cancelled
understood.paused: The client asks to wait — “{scenario}” is put aside
understood.confirm_yes: The client confirmed that everything is correct
understood.confirm_no: The client said something in the answers is wrong
understood.question: The client asked a question
understood.wants_human: The client asks for a person
understood.plain: An ordinary message: no answers to the scenario's questions and no requests

found.title: Found
found.nothing_catalog: Searched the catalog — found nothing suitable
found.nothing_knowledge: Searched the knowledge base — found nothing suitable
found.nothing_both: Searched the catalog and the knowledge base — found nothing suitable
found.none: Did not search: the answer did not need it

decided.title: Decided
decided.ask_confirm: Show the client their answers and ask to confirm
decided.ask_what_wrong: Ask what needs to be corrected
decided.wait_outside: Everything is collected in “{scenario}” — pass the request on and wait for your system's answer
decided.wait_review: Not sure about the receipt in “{scenario}” — pass it to a person to check
decided.completed: Everything is collected — “{scenario}” is finished, the request is ready
decided.handover: Call a person and stop answering
decided.variants: Not to answer the client: prepare answer variants for a person ({n})
decided.say_unknown: Say honestly that there is no such information
